# Jenike & Johanson

> Jenike & Johanson is a specialized bulk material engineering firm providing comprehensive testing, consulting, and design services for powder and solids handling challenges.

The company offers laboratory testing services for material characterization, engineering consulting for equipment design and process optimization, and pilot-scale modeling. Their expertise spans pharmaceutical, chemical, food, and industrial sectors dealing with bulk solids flow, segregation, and handling problems.

## Key Topics

- Bulk material handling
- Powder flow testing
- Discrete Element Modeling (DEM)
- Mass flow design
- Segregation testing
- Pneumatic conveying
- Ring shear tester
- Hopper design
- Material characterization
- Particle attrition
- Abrasive wear
- Powder caking
- Fluidization
- Structural engineering
- Quality control

## Bulk Material Testing Services

- [Bulk Material Testing Services](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing): Overview of comprehensive bulk material testing services for material characterization and flow problem identification
- [Bulk Material Flow Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-flow-properties): Powder flow testing service for identifying flow problems and design solutions
- [Segregation Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-segregation): Fluidization and sifting segregation analysis services
- [Particle Properties Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-particle-properties): Particle evaluation testing for size, shape, strength, and moisture interaction
- [Particle Attrition Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-particle-attrition): Particle attrition testing via impact and compression analysis methods
- [Powder Caking Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-powder-caking): Powder caking and clumping analysis including morphology and surface energy
- [Abrasive Wear Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-abrasive-wear): Abrasive wear testing for equipment liner selection and material analysis
- [Pneumatic Conveying Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-pneumatic-conveying): Pneumatic conveying testing for particle attrition, wear, and pipeline buildup
- [Powder Fluidization Testing](https://jenike.com/services/bulk-material-testing-powder-fluidization): Powder fluidization testing including air-assisted discharge assessment

## Engineering & Consulting Services

- [Material Handling Engineering Services](https://jenike.com/services/engineering-services): Material handling and processing engineering services with on-site support
- [Discrete Element Modeling (DEM) Analysis](https://jenike.com/services/discrete-element-modeling): DEM analysis service for predicting bulk material flow patterns and rates
- [Conceptual & Functional Engineering](https://jenike.com/services/conceptual-functional-engineering): Conceptual and functional engineering for silos, feeders, and transfer chutes
- [Structural Engineering](https://jenike.com/services/structural-engineering): Structural analysis and rehabilitation for bulk solids storage structures
- [Site Visit Service](https://jenike.com/services/site-visits): On-site troubleshooting and process audit service with detailed reporting

## Specialized Analysis Services

- [Moisture Migration & Caking Analysis](https://jenike.com/services/moisture-migration-caking-analysis): Moisture migration and powder caking analysis to reduce downtime and costs
- [Stockpile Drainage & Seepage Analysis](https://jenike.com/services/stockpiles-drainage-seepage-analysis): Stockpile drainage and seepage analysis for moisture control and flowability
- [Pilot-Scale Testing & Process Modeling](https://jenike.com/services/pilot-scale): Pilot-scale testing and solids process modeling with flow visualization

## Solutions & Problem-Solving
